#!/bin/sh
#############################################################
#### Use 'sbatch filename' to submit job                 ####
#### Follow the jobs progress with one of these commands ####
####      'squeue -u $USER'                              ####
####      'watch squeue -u $USER'                        ####
#### Use 'scancel job-id' to cancel the job              ####
#############################################################
#
### Job name
#SBATCH --job-name=ex2
#
### Account name
#SBATCH --account=ACCOUNT
#
# max. walltime
#SBATCH --time=00:01:00
#
### The number of nodes and tasks per node
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=3
#
### Queue name (in Slurm, this is a partition)
#SBATCH --partition=default
#
### Send us a mail when job starts execution, if it is aborted, and when it has finished
#SBATCH --mail-type=BEGIN,END,FAIL
##SBATCH --mail-user=<<e-mail address>>
#
#### Priority
#SBATCH --nice=0
#
### Non rerunable
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#
# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

# Change to the directory where the job was submitted
cd $SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR

# Load necessary modules
module load intelcomp
module load openmpi/1.4.3-intel

# Run the application using srun for better Slurm integration.
# srun automatically uses the resources allocated by Slurm.
# The total number of tasks will be (nodes * ntasks-per-node) = 3.
srun ./fem 2 6

reasons: The `--account` directive has a placeholder value 'ACCOUNT' which must be replaced with a valid account name.

The `--mail-user` directive is commented out and contains a placeholder '<<e-mail address>>'. For email notifications to work as requested by `--mail-type`, this line must be uncommented and a valid email address must be provided.
issues: The OpenMPI module version `openmpi/1.4.3-intel` is quite old. It is advisable to check for a more recent version available on the system for potential performance, feature, and security improvements.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/sh
#############################################################
#### Use 'qsub filename' to submit job                   ####
#### Follow the jobs progress with one of these commands ####
####      'qstat -a'                                     ####
####      'watch qstat -a'                               ####
#### Use 'qdel job-id' to cancel the job                 ####
#############################################################
#
### Job name
#PBS -N ex2
#
### Account name
#PBS -A ACCOUNT
#
# max. walltime (must not exceed max. walltime for queue)
#PBS -l walltime=00:01:00
#
### The number of nodes and processes per node
#PBS -lnodes=1:ppn=3
#
### Queue name
#PBS -q default
#
### Send us a mail when job starts execution, if it is aborted, and when it has finished
#PBS -m abe
##PBS -M <<e-mail address>>
#
#### Priority
#PBS -p 0
#
### Non rerunable
#PBS -r n
#
# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR

module load intelcomp
module load openmpi/1.4.3-intel

mpirun -n 3 -hostfile $PBS_NODEFILE ./fem 2 6
